items.exampleEn: We have a weekly meeting on Monday.
items.exampleZh: 我們每週一有一次例行會議。

items.exampleEn: I drink instant coffee at work.
I didn't like the ending of the book.
items.exampleZh: 我不喜歡那本書的結局。

items.exampleEn: This room gets a lot of daylight.
items.exampleZh: 這個房間照得到很多日光。

items.exampleEn: Nowadays, many people work from home.
items.exampleZh: 現在很多人都在家工作。

items.exampleEn: It is very hot at midday.
Have you heard the latest news?
items.exampleZh: 你聽說最新的消息了嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Nowadays, I read the news on my phone.
items.sentenceZh: 現在我都用手機看新聞。

items.audioEn: Our weekly meeting is on Tuesday at midday.
items.audioZh: 我們每週的會議在星期二中午。
items.questionZh: 每週的會議是什麼時候？

items.sentenceEn: The movie had a happy ending.
items.sentenceZh: 那部電影有個快樂的結局。

items.sentenceEn: This is her latest book, and I love it.
items.sentenceZh: 這是她最新的書，我很喜歡。

items.stemEn: Let's go hiking while there is still ____.
items.stemZh: 趁天還亮，我們去健行吧。
現在大多數人都有手機。

items.passageEn: Mia's family has a weekly picnic on Sundays. They leave home in the morning and eat lunch in the park at midday. They always go home before it gets dark. Last Sunday, it started to rain during lunch. Everyone ran to the car with the food. It was not a happy ending, but they laughed all the way home.
items.passageZh: Mia 一家人每週日都會去野餐。他們早上出門，中午在公園吃午餐，天黑之前一定回家。上週日，午餐吃到一半開始下雨，大家拿著食物跑回車上。結局不算愉快，但他們一路笑著回家。

items.promptZh: 那部電影一上映就大受歡迎。
referenceEn: The movie was an instant success.
The movie became an instant success.
rubricZh: instant 放在名詞前表示「立刻的」（例如 an instant success；寫 an instant hit 等其他正確說法也收）
說過去的事用過去式（例如 was）

referenceEn: Nowadays, phones are getting more and more expensive.
Phones are getting more expensive nowadays.
rubricZh: 用 nowadays 表示「現在、現今」，放句首或句尾都可以
「越來越貴」可寫，例如 are getting more and more expensive、are getting more expensive 等
